answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. The defense holds because trust accrues slowly and is lost fast, so a farm that ever submits a copied answer destroys the value of that identity. Consider a nectar as the anchor of the cost.
